steps.en: Copy the template and choose one channel and Dify application
steps.zh: 复制模板，选择一种通道与 Dify 应用

steps.en: Start the Python bridge after the channel credentials are ready
steps.zh: 通道凭据就绪后启动 Python bridge

steps.en: The selected adapter converts each incoming event into a common message context
steps.zh: 把通道事件转成统一消息

steps.en: The bridge calls the configured Dify chatbot, agent, Chatflow, or Workflow API
steps.zh: 调用 Dify 应用 API

steps.en: It parses the answer, keeps conversation state, and sends the channel reply
steps.zh: 解析答案、保存会话，再由通道回复

value.en: You inspect and adapt one bridge instead of writing Dify and channel glue from scratch.
value.zh: 你可以检查并修改一套 bridge，不必从零编写 Dify 与通道 glue。
